name: gitlab-app
description: GitLab for Starhive: link work items to merge requests and branches.

scripts.test: tsc src/branchName.ts src/sync.ts src/discover.ts --outDir .branch-name-check --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler && sed -i '' "s|from './branchName'|from './branchName.js'|" .branch-name-check/sync.js .branch-name-check/discover.js && node src/branchName.test.mjs && node src/sync.test.mjs && node src/discover.test.mjs
